name: sg-chrome
summary: Full-bleed liquid chrome rolling in slow swells. A domain-warped height field shaded as a true mirror reflecting a studio scene with hard strip lights.

flow.description: How fast the metal rolls; 0 freezes it.

relief.description: Height of the swells; low is flat, high is tilted.

ripple.description: Domain-warp folding; low is broad swells, high is tight ridges.

gloss.description: Sharpness of reflections; low is satin, high is mirror.

mouseInfluence.description: How strongly the pointer pushes into the metal.

deviations.what: The palette colours are ours, not upstream's nocturne preset.
deviations.why: Upstream's palette lives in @shader-gallery/runtime. Ours matches the CSS resting state.

deviations.what: No post chain: upstream runs grain, aberration, vignette, contrast, saturation over output.
deviations.why: The post chain is in @shader-gallery/runtime. Our CSS grain layer covers banding.
